title: Autotune Sentinel: offline batching/caching recommender and safe-apply guardrail for VPC/on-prem
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build 'Autotune Sentinel', an offline-capable recommendation and safe-apply pipeline that generates batching and KV-cache configuration suggestions for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments and applies them in a policy-governed, auditable way. The feature must operate without outbound network calls from customer VPCs (supporting air-gapped installs), provide safe defaults, produce dry-run cost/latency simulations, and enforce tenant-specific constraints (e.g., disallowed quantization, max batch latency). The outcome should reduce per-token cost while preserving SLOs and meeting enterprise compliance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel can ingest offline workload traces (token-level summaries and sequence-length histograms) exported from Private agent without needing outbound network access
Generate batching and prefix/KV-cache recommendations with expected cost delta and 95th percentile latency impact estimates for given trace
Provide a dry-run simulator that validates recommendations against a local runtime simulator producing simulated tail latencies and token throughput
Policy engine evaluates recommendations and marks any disallowed changes (e.g., >15% model quantization, batching that increases tail latency beyond SLO) with explicit reasons
Safe-apply workflow produces a staged plan that can be exported and applied by an operator; automatic rollback hook is available and documented
All recommendation runs produce an auditable artifact (signed JSON) persisted to customer-managed storage or local disk, with optional KMS-encrypted blobs
No secrets or model weights leave customer VPCs during recommendation or apply phases
E2E tests covering offline run, policy enforcement, and rollback exist in the private integration test harness and pass in CI
design_decisions: Operate in two modes: 'offline-analyze' (runs inside customer infra) and 'controller-apply' (operator-triggered; can run inside or outside customer network depending on deployment)
Use a compact trace format (sequence-length histogram + token-rate timeseries + top-k route fingerprints) to avoid exporting raw prompts and PII
Policy evaluation modeled as a declarative Rego-like rule set; hosts a local policy evaluator compiled from central policy bundle during Private installation
Dry-run simulator will reuse the existing runtime kernel performance table (local snapshot) to avoid external benchmarking calls
All artifacts signed with customer KMS keys for tamper-evidence in private deployments
implementation_notes: Component breakdown: tracer exporter (agent-side), sentinel analyzer (offline binary/container), local simulator, policy-enforcer, plan-stager, apply-cli
Agent change: add 'sentinel-trace' export endpoint that writes gzipped trace to provided mount path or S3-compatible bucket (for on-prem, local NFS path preferred)
Sentinel analyzer will include conservative heuristics for batching thresholds when traces are sparse; expose tunables in config.yaml
Policy bundle shipped as part of Private install; ops can add org-specific rules; default rules include: max-quantization=0.75, max-batch-delay-ms=50, require-kms-signature=true
Rollout mechanics: plan staging file includes pre/post checks, canary group definitions, and automatic revert condition triggers (error-rate increase or latency regression beyond threshold)
Logging: all runs must write structured logs locally and optionally to the customer's observability endpoint; no telemetry hits to Redwood-hosted endpoints unless explicitly enabled by customer
rollout_plan: Phase 0 – Spike: prototype analyzer in dev infra; validate with synthetic traces (owned by Research)
Phase 1 – Internal beta: ship containerized sentinel to internal infra and run against staging clusters; iterate heuristics
Phase 2 – Private early access: invite 2 customers on Private to run offline analyzer and provide feedback; collect signed artifacts
Phase 3 – GA: include sentinel in Private agent package and Redwood Console operators UI; enable policy editing via Console (enterprise-only)
test_plan: Unit tests for trace parser, recommendation scoring, policy evaluation
Integration tests that run offline-analyze against recorded traces and validate simulator output matches runtime metrics within 10%
Chaos test: ensure rollback triggers when simulator predicts safe but live load causes a >10% 95th latency regression
Security test: confirm artifacts are KMS-signed and cannot be uploaded to Redwood-hosted storage unless customer opt-in flag is set
monitoring: KPIs: average per-token cost delta, median and 95th latency change post-apply, frequency of policy rejections
Alerts: suspicious artifact tampering, apply operation failed to complete within window, rollback rate > 5% for a given customer
Dashboards: per-customer Sentinel runs with recommended vs applied delta, policy rejection reasons
dependencies: ENG-10112 (Private agent trace exporter - ETA Mar 2026)
ENG-97500 (local runtime kernel perf snapshot format)
